text: Implemented FixationCsv with explicit column/key/unit mapping, exact decimal-to-microsecond admission, retained row errors and whole-trial quarantine; ContrastCsv retains typed scalar/structured scores, provenance, denominators, failures and exclusions and rejects an unrelated executed plan. The exact docs/examples/StudyGuide.scala compiles and runs in the portable I/O suite. Twelve new workflow tests pass per backend within the full 2,034-execution matrix. The corrected documented CLI command wrote six real contrast rows; base R readback agrees with pinned eyesim and independent rational targets. See docs/FIXATION_STUDIES.md and PARITY.md. Local Java 25.0.1 only; no hosted CI or remote publication.
